subtitle: Offline listening
receipt: Your offline queue is saved. Both features are ready for your next day out.

stages.title: Make room for two features
stages.intro: Choose a daytime and an evening feature for your own offline queue. Open a collection to see its recording notes.
stages.notice: Every collection is instrumental, included in your subscription, and available at the same audio quality. Collections within each feature have the same duration and mood.

options.title: Open Windows
options.detail: A studio pop collection with catchy instrumental hooks and acoustic percussion. The complete set is included offline.

options.title: Scene to Scene
options.detail: Instrumental versions of songs from Hindi-language films, recorded by a Mumbai film orchestra. This Bollywood soundtrack set has no sung lyrics. The complete set is included offline.

options.title: Island Radio
options.detail: An instrumental reggae session with an offbeat guitar pulse. The complete set is included offline.

options.title: Small Hours
options.detail: A contemporary soul group plays new instrumental arrangements. The complete set is included offline.

options.title: After the Last Train
options.detail: A melodic instrumental pop EP, recorded for this radio session. The complete set is included offline.

options.title: Lantern Session
options.detail: A relaxed instrumental R&B set recorded by a small studio ensemble. The complete set is included offline.

options.title: The Soul Room
options.detail: Instrumental soul tracks with a small brass section and gentle drums. The complete set is included offline.

options.title: Closing Credits
options.detail: A Bollywood instrumental collection drawn from Hindi-film closing themes, played by their Mumbai soundtrack musicians. No sung lyrics. The complete set is included offline.

stages.title: The catalog has refreshed
stages.intro: The earlier recordings are no longer available offline. New editions are ready, and the station has inserted two featured replacements. Review the new recording notes and update either feature if you wish.
stages.notice: All replacements are available now. Audio quality, duration, mood and subscription cost are unchanged.

options.title: From the Archive
options.detail: New instrumental arrangements of Bollywood film songs. These Hindi-cinema melodies were recorded by a Mumbai soundtrack ensemble; there are no sung lyrics.

options.title: Scene to Scene: Radio Cut
options.detail: A new instrumental pop session from the series’ house band. The compositions were written for the radio recording. This is today's featured station selection.

options.detail: A new instrumental soul set with brass and gentle drums.

stages.title: Your final lineup
stages.intro: The station suggests its two featured recordings for today. You can preview that lineup or save the two features currently shown below. Each collection can still be changed.
stages.notice: Saving your current lineup and using the station lineup take the same time. Both are included and ready offline.
